source.title: GRBL v1.1 resmî hata ve alarm kodu tabloları (doc/csv)

note: İngilizce açıklamalar resmî tablodan birebir; Türkçe anlamlar bunun çevirisidir.

entries.title: Expected command letter
entries.description_en: G-code words consist of a letter and a value. Letter was not found.
entries.meaning_tr: Satırda adres harfi bekleniyordu ama bulunamadı (ör. sayı harfsiz yazılmış).

entries.title: Bad number format
entries.description_en: Missing the expected G-code word value or numeric value format is not valid.
entries.meaning_tr: Adres harfinden sonra sayı yok ya da sayı biçimi geçersiz.

entries.title: Invalid statement
entries.description_en: Grbl '$' system command was not recognized or supported.

entries.title: Value < 0
entries.description_en: Negative value received for an expected positive value.

entries.title: Setting disabled
entries.description_en: Homing cycle failure. Homing is not enabled via settings.

entries.title: Value < 3 usec
entries.description_en: Minimum step pulse time must be greater than 3usec.

entries.title: EEPROM read fail. Using defaults
entries.description_en: An EEPROM read failed. Auto-restoring affected EEPROM to default values.

entries.title: Not idle
entries.description_en: Grbl '$' command cannot be used unless Grbl is IDLE. Ensures smooth operation during a job.

entries.title: G-code lock
entries.description_en: G-code commands are locked out during alarm or jog state.
entries.meaning_tr: Makine alarm ya da jog durumundayken G-code kabul edilmez.
actions: Alarmı sıfırla ($X veya homing), sonra programı yeniden başlat.

entries.title: Homing not enabled
entries.description_en: Soft limits cannot be enabled without homing also enabled.

entries.title: Line overflow
entries.description_en: Max characters per line exceeded. Received command line was not executed.
entries.meaning_tr: Satır, GRBL'nin satır başına karakter sınırını aşıyor; satır çalıştırılmadı.

entries.title: Step rate > 30kHz
entries.description_en: Grbl '$' setting value cause the step rate to exceed the maximum supported.

entries.title: Check Door
entries.description_en: Safety door detected as opened and door state initiated.

entries.title: Line length exceeded
entries.description_en: Build info or startup line exceeded EEPROM line length limit. Line not stored.

entries.title: Travel exceeded
entries.description_en: Jog target exceeds machine travel. Jog command has been ignored.
entries.meaning_tr: Jog hedefi makine kursunu aşıyor; jog komutu yok sayıldı.

entries.title: Invalid jog command
entries.description_en: Jog command has no '=' or contains prohibited g-code.

entries.title: Setting disabled
entries.description_en: Laser mode requires PWM output.

entries.title: Unsupported command
entries.description_en: Unsupported or invalid g-code command found in block.
entries.meaning_tr: Satırda GRBL'nin desteklemediği ya da geçersiz bir G kodu var.
actions: Satırdaki G kodunu GRBL'nin desteklediği eşdeğerle değiştir (GRBL'de delme döngüsü ve M6 yoktur).

entries.title: Modal group violation
entries.description_en: More than one g-code command from same modal group found in block.
entries.meaning_tr: Aynı satırda aynı modal gruptan birden fazla G kodu var.

entries.title: Undefined feed rate
entries.description_en: Feed rate has not yet been set or is undefined.
entries.meaning_tr: İlerleme hızı (F) henüz verilmemiş.
actions: İlk G1/G2/G3 satırından önce F değeri ver.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:23
entries.description_en: G-code command in block requires an integer value.
entries.meaning_tr: Bu G kodu tam sayı değer gerektiriyor.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:24
entries.description_en: More than one g-code command that requires axis words found in block.
entries.meaning_tr: Aynı satırda eksen kelimesi isteyen birden fazla G kodu var.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:25
entries.description_en: Repeated g-code word found in block.
entries.meaning_tr: Aynı adres harfi satırda tekrar ediyor.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:26
entries.description_en: No axis words found in block for g-code command or current modal state which requires them.
entries.meaning_tr: Bu komut veya aktif modal durum eksen kelimesi gerektiriyor ama satırda yok.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:27
entries.description_en: Line number value is invalid.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:28
entries.description_en: G-code command is missing a required value word.
entries.meaning_tr: G kodunun gerektirdiği bir değer kelimesi eksik.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:29
entries.description_en: G59.x work coordinate systems are not supported.
entries.meaning_tr: G59.x iş koordinat sistemleri desteklenmiyor.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:30
entries.description_en: G53 only allowed with G0 and G1 motion modes.
entries.meaning_tr: G53 yalnızca G0 ve G1 ile kullanılabilir.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:31
entries.description_en: Axis words found in block when no command or current modal state uses them.
entries.meaning_tr: Satırda eksen kelimesi var ama onu kullanacak komut veya modal durum yok.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:32
entries.description_en: G2 and G3 arcs require at least one in-plane axis word.
entries.meaning_tr: G2/G3 yayı düzlemde en az bir eksen kelimesi gerektirir.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:33
entries.description_en: Motion command target is invalid.
entries.meaning_tr: Hareket hedefi geçersiz (ör. yay geometrisi tutarsız).
actions: Yayın başlangıç, bitiş ve merkez değerlerini kontrol et.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:34
entries.description_en: Arc radius value is invalid.
entries.meaning_tr: Yay yarıçapı (R) geçersiz.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:35
entries.description_en: G2 and G3 arcs require at least one in-plane offset word.
entries.meaning_tr: G2/G3 yayı düzlemde en az bir merkez ofseti (I/J/K) gerektirir.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:36
entries.description_en: Unused value words found in block.
entries.meaning_tr: Satırda kullanılmayan değer kelimeleri var.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:37
entries.description_en: G43.1 dynamic tool length offset is not assigned to configured tool length axis.

entries.title: Invalid gcode ID:38
entries.description_en: Tool number greater than max supported value.
entries.meaning_tr: Takım numarası desteklenen en büyük değeri aşıyor.

entries.title: Hard limit
entries.description_en: Hard limit has been triggered. Machine position is likely lost due to sudden halt. Re-homing is highly recommended.
entries.meaning_tr: Donanım limit anahtarı tetiklendi. Ani duruş nedeniyle makine konumu muhtemelen kayboldu; yeniden homing şiddetle önerilir.
actions: Limit anahtarını serbest bırak, makineyi yeniden homing yap.

entries.title: Soft limit
entries.description_en: Soft limit alarm. G-code motion target exceeds machine travel. Machine position retained. Alarm may be safely unlocked.
entries.meaning_tr: Yazılımsal limit: G-code hareket hedefi makine kursunu aşıyor. Makine konumu korunur; alarm güvenle kaldırılabilir.
actions: Eksen kursu aşımı: iş sıfırını (G54) veya parçanın tabladaki yerini kontrol et; doğrulama raporundaki E040'a bak.

entries.title: Abort during cycle
entries.description_en: Reset while in motion. Machine position is likely lost due to sudden halt. Re-homing is highly recommended.
entries.meaning_tr: Hareket sırasında reset. Makine konumu muhtemelen kayboldu; yeniden homing önerilir.

entries.title: Probe fail
entries.description_en: Probe fail. Probe is not in the expected initial state before starting probe cycle when G38.2 and G38.3 is not triggered and G38.4 and G38.5 is triggered.
entries.meaning_tr: Prob hatası: prob, döngü başlamadan önce beklenen durumda değil.

entries.title: Probe fail
entries.description_en: Probe fail. Probe did not contact the workpiece within the programmed travel for G38.2 and G38.4.
entries.meaning_tr: Prob hatası: prob, programlanan mesafe içinde parçaya temas etmedi.

entries.title: Homing fail
entries.description_en: Homing fail. The active homing cycle was reset.
entries.meaning_tr: Homing hatası: homing döngüsü resetlendi.

entries.title: Homing fail
entries.description_en: Homing fail. Safety door was opened during homing cycle.
entries.meaning_tr: Homing hatası: homing sırasında güvenlik kapısı açıldı.

entries.title: Homing fail
entries.description_en: Homing fail. Pull off travel failed to clear limit switch. Try increasing pull-off setting or check wiring.
entries.meaning_tr: Homing hatası: geri çekilme limit anahtarını bırakamadı.

entries.title: Homing fail
entries.description_en: Homing fail. Could not find limit switch within search distances. Try increasing max travel, decreasing pull-off distance, or check wiring.
entries.meaning_tr: Homing hatası: limit anahtarı arama mesafesi içinde bulunamadı.

entries.title: Homing fail
entries.description_en: Homing fail. Second dual axis limit switch failed to trigger within configured search distance after first. Try increasing trigger fail distance or check wiring.
entries.meaning_tr: Homing hatası: çift eksenin ikinci limit anahtarı tetiklenmedi.
